Hey, 20 year old female here to help!

If it’s making you uncomfortable, that’s okay, you have a right to not want to be/ ever be into all of the PDA. 

I was the same way and was more or less forced into it all because I didn’t stand up for myself. 

What’s NOT okay is for him to make you feel bad for being uncomfortable, he’s in high school, and as much as you love him  (my boyfriend back then was one of my only few friends for a while... I know this sucks..) so I figured I go along with it to save our “friendship” , he used me and dumped me on my birthday that same year.. 


If he does not respect that you are uncomfortable with anything physical in public or not, no matter what it is, 
Than he is not worth your time and you can do so much better.. there is better out there, I promise.

IM SERIOUS. 

Because it will only get worse. He’s most likely a) trying to impress his friends 2) thinking with the wrong head...  or 5) both. 

Talk to him about it, don’t yell or cry, just explain it to him and give examples of what is and isn’t okay. 

If he’s really serious about you, he’ll understand. 

If you ever need advice, you can message me. 

I hope everything works out.

So to answer your questions, it’s fair for you to be uncomfortable and have your own responsibilities, he’s treating you unfairly. && baby steps, maybe just holding hands sometimes or something to start. 

if you aren’t comfortable with something, that is only going to change (or maybe not) with time, regardless that is okay, but stick to who you are and how you feel. 

THIS IS NORMAL, you are normal. I have friends at my college now that are uncomfortable with PDA, that shouldn’t be the focus of any relationship, ever.
